title: Chihaya Anon's Laugh
description: A random usage of replacing the end flash
body:
![Screenshot of this pack](https://user-assets.sxlcdn.com/images/451416/FtYlBozNC8J4JJQhq-QPxXUMs_z2.png)

A simple resourcepack to replace traditional **End Flash** texture to a famous meme in the **[BanG Dream!](https://mzh.moegirl.org.cn/BanG_Dream! "BanG Dream!")**-related community, **Chihaya Anon's laugh.**

# How to choose varients?

- **AnonLaugh Basic** - Replaced End Flash only, while keeping the original sound.
- **AnonLaugh Plus** - Replaced End Flash and its sound. 

# Version Support

Supports Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.9 and later.
